hooks.command: if echo "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATHS" | grep -qE '\.(ts|tsx|js|jsx|json|md|css|html|yaml|yml)$'; then npx prettier --write "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATHS" 2>/dev/null; fi
if echo "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATHS" | grep -qE '\.(ts|tsx)$'; then npx tsc --noEmit --skipLibCheck 2>/dev/null || echo 'TypeScript errors detected'; fi
if echo "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATHS" | grep -qE '\.py$'; then ruff check --fix "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATHS" 2>/dev/null && black --quiet "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATHS" 2>/dev/null; fi
